title: Require an unambiguous leading character for opaque federation references
outcome: Federation lookup references reject dot-only and option-like tokens, with the L1 credential namespace contract preserved.
acceptance: Validate reference tokens with a leading ASCII alphanumeric and the documented bounded suffix alphabet, rejecting '.', '..', leading '-' and leading '.'.
Cover references in enrollment/endpoint/admission inputs and ensure no paths, raw secrets or global credential writes are introduced.
